hook_top: Buyer ne aapki factory Google ki…
hook_main: …aur order kisi aur ko de diya.
label: GALTI
points: Website hai hi nahi.
“Sirf IndiaMART listing? Shayad trader hai, manufacturer nahi.”
Ek simple 1-page website: factory photos, product range, contact.
Product photos phone ke, dark aur blurry.
“Photo itni kharab hai, toh product quality kaisi hogi?”
Daylight mein, plain background par, har product ki 3 clear photos.
Capacity aur certification chhupa hua hai.
“Yeh mera bulk order handle kar payega ya nahi?”
Homepage par likho: monthly capacity, MOQ, ISO / certifications.
Contact sirf ek form — reply 3 din baad.
“Itna slow hai, toh delivery bhi late karega.”
WhatsApp button lagao. Har inquiry ka reply same day.
Proof zero hai.
“Kisi aur ne inse kabhi kharida bhi hai?”
Client logos, export countries aur 30-sec factory walkthrough video.
caption:
Buyer ne aapki factory Google ki… aur order kisi aur ko chala gaya. 😶

Yeh 5 galtiyan check karo — kitni aapki website/profile mein hain?

hook_top: RFQ aaya. Quote bhej diya. Phir…
label: STEP
points: Inquiry aate hi confirm karo.
Quote ready hone tak chup rehti hain. Buyer tab tak 3 aur supplier se baat kar leta hai.
Pehle ghante mein: “Mil gaya, specs confirm kar rahe hain, kal tak quote.”
Ek price nahi, options do.
Ek single price bhejti hain. Buyer ke paas sirf haan ya na.
2–3 quantity slabs + sample option. Buyer compare karta hai, aapke saath.
Follow-up ka calendar banao.
Ek baar “any update?” bhej ke chhod deti hain.
Day 2: specs. Day 5: delivery timeline. Day 10: decision kab hoga?
Har RFQ track karo.
Inquiries WhatsApp aur email mein bikhri rehti hain. Kaunsi pending hai, kisi ko yaad nahi.
Ek sheet: buyer, product, quote date, next follow-up, status.
caption:
RFQ aaya, quote bheja… aur phir silence. 🦗

Zyaadatar orders price se nahi, slow follow-up se jaate hain. Yeh 4 steps apni team ke saath set karo.

hook_main: Buyer page 2 par band kar deta hai.
label: FIX
points: Pehle page par top 3 products.
Pehla page company history aur chairman ka message.
Page 1: aapke 3 best-selling products, photo + key spec.
Har product par MOQ aur lead time.
Buyer ko basic sawaal ke liye call karna padta hai.
Har product ke saath: MOQ, lead time, packing size.
PDF bhej ke chup mat raho.
Catalogue bheja, buyer ne download kiya, baat khatam.
Saath mein likho: “Aapke industry ke liye yeh 3 products best hain.”
WhatsApp-friendly version banao.
20 MB ki PDF phone par khulti hi nahi.
2–3 MB ka short version + har page par WhatsApp number.
caption:
50 page ka catalogue… aur buyer page 2 par hi band kar deta hai. 📕

Catalogue ka kaam impress karna nahi, buyer ko agla step lene par majboor karna hai.

label: CHECK

“Welcome to our company, established in…”
Ek line: kya banate ho, kiske liye, kitni capacity.
Spec sheets.
Spec chahiye toh form bharo, phir wait karo.

RFQ form.
Naam, email, message. Bas.
Product, quantity, delivery date, destination — ek baar mein poori detail.

Reply speed.

Inquiry aate hi sales team ke WhatsApp par alert.
caption:

hook_main: Toh aap price war khel rahe ho.
label: REASON
points: Ek buyer, 10 supplier.
Wahi inquiry 10 aur factories ko bhi jaati hai. Jo sasta, woh jeeta.
Aisi jagah bhi dikho jahan aap akele ho: apni website, Google, LinkedIn.
Aapka brand, unka platform.
Buyer ko yaad rehta hai “IndiaMART se liya tha”, aapka naam nahi.
Har order ke baad buyer ko apni website aur WhatsApp se jodo.
Algorithm badla, leads gaye.
Platform ke rules badle toh aapki inquiries bhi gayi.
Apni contact list banao: repeat buyers ka WhatsApp group ya email list.
Achhe buyer wahan search hi nahi karte.
Bade importers aur OEMs Google aur referrals se supplier dhoondhte hain.
Google Business Profile + website par case studies.
caption:
Saare leads sirf IndiaMART se? Toh har order price war hai. ⚔️

Platform bura nahi — par sirf platform par rehna risky hai.

hook_top: Foreign buyer aapse pehli baar baat kar raha hai.
label: CHECK
points: Kya yeh factory sach mein hai?
“Photos stock images toh nahi?”
Factory ka asli walkthrough video, machines aur team ke saath.
Kya yeh export kar chuke hain?
“Mera pehla consignment test toh nahi banega?”
Export countries ki list aur shipping documents ka sample (details hide karke).
Quality kaise pakki karenge?
“Batch mein variation aaya toh?”
Certifications, testing process aur QC report ka format.
Baat karna aasaan hai?
“Problem aayi toh kisse baat karunga?”
Ek English-speaking contact person, fixed reply time.
caption:
Foreign buyer pehli call mein yeh 4 cheezein check karta hai. 🌍

Inme se ek bhi missing ho, toh deal wahi atak jaati hai.

label: MESSAGE
points: Quote ke 2 din baad.
“Sir, any update?”
“Aapke spec mein ek aur option hai jo cost kam kar sakta hai — details bhejun?”
Jab buyer chup ho.
“Sir please reply.”
“Kya decision mein koi aur bhi involved hai? Unke liye short summary bhej doon?”
Sample ke baad.
“Sir sample kaisa laga?”
“Sample ke 3 points check karne ke liye ek 10-min call — kal ya parson?”
Deal atki ho toh.
“Sir best price de denge.”
“Abhi timing sahi nahi lag rahi. Main next quarter check karun?”
caption:
“Sir, any update?” — yeh follow-up nahi, request hai. 🙏

Yeh 4 messages try karo, jo buyer ko reply karne ki wajah dete hain.
